issues.t: Engine stalls from failing fuel pump (recall)
issues.sym: The engine runs rough, warning lights come on, or the car stalls while driving and may not restart.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump inside the tank uses an impeller that can swell and stick, cutting off fuel. Toyota and Lexus recalled millions of vehicles for it, including the 2018-2020 LC 500 and LC 500h.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls or with a Lexus dealer. The new pump is installed free. If the engine stumbles or stalls, get off the road safely and have it towed rather than driven.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump can crack and leak fuel (recall)
issues.sym: A raw fuel smell from the engine bay, or wetness around the top of the engine. There may be no warning at all before a leak starts.
issues.why: A part inside the engine-mounted high-pressure fuel pump can be damaged, letting the pump cover crack. Leaking fuel near a hot engine is a fire risk, so Lexus recalled early 2018 LC 500s to replace the pumps.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, don't drive the car; park it outside and away from buildings and call a dealer. Check your VIN to confirm the free pump replacement was done.

issues.t: Brake assist and stability control can shut off (recall)
issues.sym: Brake and stability control warning lights come on and the brake pedal needs much more effort than normal to stop the car.
issues.why: The electric pump that powers the brake booster can fail. When it does, the car loses brake assist and stability control, so stopping distances get longer. Lexus recalled some 2019 LC 500s.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. If the brake warning lights come on, slow down gently, leave extra room and have the car checked before driving further. Check your VIN; the dealer inspects the pump and replaces it free if needed.

issues.t: Backup camera image shows up late (recall)
issues.sym: When you shift into reverse, the rear camera picture takes several seconds to appear on the screen.
issues.why: The parking-assist computer was programmed incorrectly at the factory, delaying the camera image. Lexus recalled 2024 LC 500 and LC 500h coupes and convertibles, along with other models.
issues.next: Get the free software update at a Lexus dealer. Until then, wait for the image and use your mirrors and a look over your shoulder before backing up.

issues.t: Door handle stays out or door won't open
issues.sym: The flush outside door handle won't pop out or won't tuck back in, sticks out while driving, or the door won't open from inside or outside.
issues.why: Each door handle is moved by a small electric actuator inside the door. Owners report water from rain or car washes reaching the actuator, which corrodes it, and plastic gear teeth can break. It's a well-known problem on early LCs.
issues.next: Don't force the handle in or out, which can strip the gears. Have a dealer or Lexus specialist replace the handle actuator or handle assembly. If a door won't open at all, get it fixed promptly, since it can slow getting out in an emergency.

issues.t: Brakes squeal or squeak
issues.sym: A high-pitched squeal or squeak from the front or rear brakes, usually at low speed or when stopping gently.
issues.why: The LC uses high-friction brake pads chosen for strong stopping power, and that pad material tends to squeal. Lexus has a service bulletin offering quieter pads for owners who find the noise annoying.
issues.next: First have the brakes inspected to rule out worn pads. If the brakes are healthy, ask the dealer about the alternative pads in the Lexus bulletin.

issues.t: Squawk or knock from the engine bay when braking
issues.sym: A squawk or knocking sound from under the hood when you press or release the brake pedal, whether parked or driving.
issues.why: Lexus issued a service bulletin for some 2018-2021 LC 500 and LC 500h cars with this noise and a specific repair procedure.
issues.next: Mention the bulletin (L-SB-0006-21) to the dealer. Have the brakes checked if the pedal feel changes too.

issues.t: Spring noise when lifting off the gas pedal
issues.sym: A twang or spring-like noise near your feet when you let go of the accelerator pedal.
issues.why: Lexus issued a service bulletin for some 2018-2021 LC 500 and LC 500h cars (and 2021 convertibles) that make this sound when the pedal returns.
issues.next: It's not a safety issue, but if the pedal ever feels sticky or slow to return, get it checked right away. Otherwise ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0002-19.

issues.t: Electric parking brake warning message
issues.sym: A parking brake malfunction warning appears on the dash, and the parking brake may not set or release normally.
issues.why: Lexus found that some 2018-2019 LC and LS cars store a fault for the electric parking brake actuator (code C13A8) and issued a repair bulletin.
issues.next: Park on level ground and use Park until it is fixed. Have a dealer read the codes and follow bulletin L-SB-0048-18.

issues.t: Low oil warning when the oil level is fine
issues.sym: A low engine oil alert comes on even though the dipstick or oil level check shows the oil is full.
issues.why: Some 2018 LC 500s give a false low-oil alert; Lexus released a bulletin with a fix.
issues.next: Always confirm the oil level first; never ignore a real low reading. If the level is correct, ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0042-18.

issues.t: Navigation freezes, goes black or resets
issues.sym: The navigation screen freezes while planning a route, a menu goes black, the system restarts by itself, or the weather voice reads the wrong temperature units.
issues.why: Software bugs in the 2018 LC's navigation unit. Lexus released a software update.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the navigation software update in bulletin L-SB-0172-17.

issues.t: Rattle from the high-mounted brake light
issues.sym: A rattle from the rear of the car near the top-center brake light while driving.
issues.why: On some 2018 cars the brake light's lens separates from its housing and rattles. Lexus has a repair bulletin.
issues.next: Check that the light still works. Ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0182-17.

issues.t: Uneven A/C airflow or vents won't switch
issues.sym: Some vents blow warmer or weaker than others, one or more vents blow little or no air, or air won't move to the vents you select.
issues.why: The small motors that move the climate system's air doors can fault and store codes. Lexus issued a bulletin for 2018-2020 LC 500 and LC 500h.
issues.next: If the defroster doesn't work, have it fixed before driving in fog or frost. Ask the dealer about bulletin L-SB-0009-22.

issues.t: Water pump coolant leak
issues.sym: Pink or red coolant drips under the front of the car, a sweet smell after driving, or the coolant level drops.
issues.why: Lexus has a bulletin on coolant leaks from the engine water pump that covers many 2008-2021 models, and it's listed for the LC.
issues.next: Keep an eye on the coolant level and the temperature gauge. If it climbs, pull over and turn the engine off. Have the leak found and the pump replaced if it's the source.

issues.t: Hybrid system warning in freezing weather
issues.sym: On a cold day, below about 32°F, the hybrid system warning light comes on, often at startup.
issues.why: Lexus found that in freezing weather some hybrids record high-voltage circuit fault codes (P1C8449 or P300449) and issued a repair bulletin.
issues.next: Pull over safely if power drops. Have a dealer read the codes and perform the repair in bulletin LSB005523.

issues.t: Hard starting with lean check engine codes
issues.sym: The engine takes a long time to start, or the check engine light comes on with codes P0171, P0174 or P0087.
issues.why: Lexus traced this to low fuel pressure in some 2013-2020 models and issued a bulletin with a repair procedure. It's related to the in-tank fuel pump problem.
issues.next: Check that the fuel pump recall is done, then have a dealer follow bulletin LSB000523.

issues.t: Musty smell after water gets inside
issues.sym: A damp, musty or moldy smell in the cabin, sometimes with wet carpet.
issues.why: When water gets into the car, from a leak or a blocked drain, the carpet and padding hold moisture. Lexus has a bulletin on cleaning this up for many 2005-2022 models.
issues.next: Find and fix the source of the water first. Then have the interior dried and treated, following Lexus bulletin L-SB-0004-22.

issues.t: Water on the floor from a blocked A/C drain
issues.sym: Water drips onto the front floor when the A/C is running, or you hear sloshing behind the dash.
issues.why: In some regions insects nest in the A/C drain hose and block it, so water backs up into the cabin. Lexus offers a bug-resistant drain tip.
issues.next: Have the drain hose cleared and ask about the bug-resistant tip in bulletin L-SB-0024-21. Dry the carpet quickly to avoid mold.

issues.t: A/C blows warm from a refrigerant leak
issues.sym: The air conditioning slowly gets weaker and starts blowing warm air.
issues.why: Refrigerant leaks out somewhere in the system. Lexus issued a bulletin for the 2018 LC with a dye kit to help find where.
issues.next: Don't just recharge it; have a shop find and fix the leak using dye or a leak detector.

issues.t: Lurching or clunky shifts at low speed
issues.sym: Abrupt downshifts or a lurch when slowing in traffic, small engine-speed jumps when coasting, or a clunk on some upshifts in manual mode. It's often smoother once the car is warm.
issues.why: Owners of LC 500s with the 10-speed automatic describe this, especially in Normal or Eco mode. Dealers have often called it normal, and there is no LC recall for it.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for transmission software updates and to drive the car with you when it happens. Get it checked right away if the car slips, flares or won't go into gear.

issues.t: Convertible top leaks or lets light in at the pillar
issues.sym: Daylight shows through a gap where the soft top meets the passenger-side windshield pillar, or rain or water gets into the cabin at highway speed.
issues.why: The soft top and windshield pillar seal can be misaligned. Lexus issued a bulletin for the gap on 2022-2024 LC 500 Convertibles, and owners report water leaks that needed the seal reset.
issues.next: Have the dealer check and realign the top and seal under warranty. Dry the interior quickly if water got in.

issues.t: Car pulls to one side or steering wheel off center
issues.sym: The car drifts left or right on a straight road, or the steering wheel is crooked while driving straight.
issues.why: Lexus says this is often tire-related, not an alignment problem. LC tires are mounted as matched sets at the factory, and moving them around can cause a pull. Road crown can also cause it.
issues.next: Have the tire pressures and tire positions checked before paying for an alignment. Lexus bulletins L-SB-0023-20 and L-SB-0001-19 explain the checks.

issues.t: Shift lever knob works loose
issues.sym: The gear shifter knob feels loose, turns, or sits crooked compared with the console.
issues.why: Owners of 2025 LCs report the threaded knob unscrewing over time.
issues.next: Turn it clockwise to snug it by hand. If it keeps loosening, ask the dealer to check it under warranty.
